'''Jekk Seejo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who worked for the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the first months of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Seejo owned the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] ''[[Good Feeling]]'' and he would often try and persuade his co-workers into using it as a guinea pig for some of the corporation's more outlandish products. Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] began purging [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] from employment in major defense firms and Seejo was reduced to being a subcontractor for [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom]]. He continued to work only when his friends in Incom brought him in on engineering projects. He flew the ''Good Feeling'' to [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] with a group of Incom and [[Sublight Products Corporation|Subpro]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], who were developing a ship in the [[Imperial Testing Grounds]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Outer Moon]]. However, the ship was attacked by [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] and Seejo sent out a distress call. This was received by a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents, who had just arrived in the [[Star system/Legends|system]] and they helped to save the ship.

The ship was infested with mynocks again and Seejo was sacked and had the ship confiscated. His former employers sent him to Prakith on the next [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. However, the Empire's anti-alien views made it impossible for him to find a job. While [[Alcohol/Legends|drinking]] in the [[Mother Lode Cantina]] in [[Prak City]], he was beaten up by a group of COMPNOR thugs. However, the Alderaanian Resistance agents were able to save him from their clutches.
